title_lines: 美国二季度GDP增速低于预期
仅增1.5% 消费支出仍强劲
核心PCE回落至3.3% 就业市场稳健
title_highlights: 美国二季度GDP增速低于预期
仅增1.5% 消费支出仍强劲
核心PCE回落至3.3% 就业市场稳健

subtitles.en: The numbers aren't really all that good this morning.
subtitles.zh: 今早的数据其实并不乐观。

subtitles.en: We haven't had a lot of numbers like this in a while. And they are backward looking because it's first quarter or second quarter GDP.
subtitles.zh: 我们很久没看到这样的数据了，而且这是第一或第二季度的GDP，属于滞后指标。

subtitles.en: You got to go back to April, May and June comes in at one and a half percent.
subtitles.zh: 回顾四月到六月，GDP增速为1.5%。

subtitles.en: That's after a 2.1 percent rise in the first quarter and it's below the 2 percent that was anticipated.
subtitles.zh: 此前第一季度增长2.1%，低于预期的2%。

subtitles.en: Now personal consumption was higher for the quarter, 3.2 percent than in the first quarter, 0.5 percent.
subtitles.zh: 本季度个人消费支出增长3.2%，高于第一季度的0.5%。

subtitles.en: But it started off strong in the first quarter and then was revised down.
subtitles.zh: 但第一季度开局强劲，随后被下修。

subtitles.en: The latest numbers on income and spending, which go into this second quarter report are from June, incomes up just 2.10s after 7.10s the prior month, personal spending up 3.10s.
subtitles.zh: 最新收入与支出数据（来自六月）显示，收入环比仅增0.2%，前月为0.7%；个人支出环比增0.3%。

subtitles.en: It was up 9.10s in the month of May.
subtitles.zh: 五月个人支出环比增长0.9%。

subtitles.en: So when you average that out, it's still not a good number in terms of the consumer.
subtitles.zh: 因此平均来看，消费端数据依然不佳。

subtitles.en: We'll have to see whether or not that continues to be revised.
subtitles.zh: 我们需要观察后续是否会继续修正。

subtitles.en: The PCE price index, everybody's been kind of waiting on that although they can figure it out.
subtitles.zh: PCE价格指数，大家都在等这个数据，尽管他们也能推算出来。

subtitles.en: Down a 10th of 8 percent, as forecast, it was up half a percent in the month of May on a year over year basis that leaves us at 3.7 percent.
subtitles.zh: 环比下降0.1%，符合预期，5月同比上涨0.5%，年率降至3.7%。

subtitles.en: That's down from 4.1 percent. The core PCE number is at an increase of one 10th of 8 percent, much lower than the 3.10s we had in May.
subtitles.zh: 低于之前的4.1%。核心PCE环比上涨0.1%，远低于5月的0.3%。

subtitles.en: And a year over year basis, we fall from 3.4 to 3.3 percent.

clip_research.source_claim: US GDP grew 1.5% in Q2, below 2% expected, after 2.1% in Q1; personal consumption 3.2% vs 0.5% in Q1; June income up 0.2%, spending up 0.3%.
clip_research.public_baseline: BEA advance estimate shows Q2 2024 GDP grew 2.8%, not 1.5%. Q1 2024 GDP was 1.3% (second estimate) or 1.4% (advance), not 2.1%. Personal consumption in Q2 2024 was not 3.2%.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip's numbers (1.5% Q2, 2.1% Q1, 3.2% consumption) do not match BEA data for 2024. They appear to be from a different year (possibly 2026 based on search snippets).

evidence.fact: BEA advance estimate for Q2 2024: GDP increased 2.8%.
BEA second estimate for Q1 2024: GDP increased 1.3%.
Real consumer spending increased 3.2% in Q2 2026, not 2024.

forbidden_claims: The clip's GDP figures are for 2024.
The clip's consumption figure is for 2024.

notes: The clip's GDP and consumption figures do not match BEA data for 2024. They appear to be from 2026 based on search results. The clip may be misdated or from a future year.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
